name: 23m kit
notes: Middle Way's current 'ערכת טריקליין Trickline' (middlewayslacklines.com/trickline/, checked 2026-09-29) is this kit: 23 m of 50 mm polyester webbing, ₪600, tree protectors included. Published webbing specs: 80 g/m, 4 % stretch, MBS 42 kN. Tensioned by one ERGO ratchet with a long handle and a double gear (one ratchet, not two). Also includes 2 extra-strong anchor slings (7 t) and 2 stainless shackles (11 t).

name: Level 2 Kit
description: Our Trickline kit comes with everything you need to take your tricklining to the next level: double ratchets, power paddle, soft release, (2) 8-foot round slings, 100 feet of our burley 10,000 lb break strength trickline webbing, tree protection, and arguably the most important part, two 10-foot sections of 11mm static rope to back up your system.

name: Super Jumpline Slackline Set
description: Thanks to a special weave method from SLACKTIVITY®, the Super Jumpline Slackline Set offers great jump-power! The light orange webbing has great visibility when landing the tricks, has smooth but powerful bounce, allowing great amplitude for air tricks and it has a really soft feel to the body.

name: Trickline Kit - Pro Line 25
description: The Professional slackline kit to jump and have fun. The sling and shackles give you security in your anchors. With the 2m and 3m sling you can set up your line even with very large trees.

name: Kit Freestyle 22m - Andy Lewis X13
description: If it talks to you, you are at the right place! Here, we're talking about Freestyle! The Andy Lewis Freestyle Kit is THE kit to practice aerial slackline.

name: BOSS LINE KIT
description: Inspired by the evolution of tricklining, the BOSS LINE is designed to replicate a pro competition slackline and support advanced tricks. Featuring trampoline-style webbing with rubber grip and the Alpha Ratchet system with extended handle, slow release, independent anchoring and safety backup line line, this kit delivers ultimate power for high-level training. For the advanced slackliner.

name: TRICK LINE KIT
description: The TRICK LINE offers dynamic movement and bounce for tricklining, the branch of the sport that goes beyond walking by adding jumps, spins and rotations. Featuring trampoline-style webbing with rubber grip and a backup line system, this kit is ideal for intermediate users and beginner tricks.
notes: Manufacturer specs (slacklineindustries.com): 50 ft (15 m), 2 in (50 mm), webbing strength 3 tons (29.89 kN), max user weight 300 lb (136 kg), age 8 and up, SKU SI11550Z. Felt tree wraps with Velcro closures and a backup line are included. The page does not say how many ratchets. Single ratchet read from the manufacturer's product photo. Shopify ship weight 7.0 lb is packed, so weight is left null.

name: TRICKLINE KIT - TRICK LINE 30
notes: Spider's US shop (slacklines.us), SKU TKS04. 30 m total length: a 25 m Trick Line webbing plus the ratchet sling. 50 mm dynamic polyester with anti-slip pro-grip printing. Includes 1 Hummer ratchet on a 40 cm sling, 1 Hummer soft release, 2 m and 3 m 1 t slings, 2 stainless 12 mm 1.5 t shackles and a bag. Tree protection is sold separately. No MBS or kit weight published. Listed sold out on slacklines.us on 2026-09-29. Description left blank because a verbatim copy of the blurb could not be fetched (the shop rate-limits).

name: DUOred
notes: Slackliner.de's 8-piece set around their own Sigma Slacklines 'DUOred' 50 mm webbing (two-tone red/purple or red/orange), sold in 15 m and 25 m versions. This row records the 25 m one. Stretch at break 6 %, >4 % at 1000 kg. Includes a ratchet, stainless shackles, 2 m tree slings and a 2 m × 15 cm felt 'Baumschutz plus'. 6.3 kg is the shipping weight, so weight is left null. Marketed as a jump-capable beginner line. The live page is a 404, so the product URL is the Wayback snapshot from 2023-01-28. Description left blank because only a German page exists.

name: Kit Elastic Line 50mm
notes: Manufacturer specs (beraadventure.com.br), SKU KEL50MM30METROS: 30 m of printed 100 % polyester 50 mm webbing (red, brand 'Elastic Line'), aimed at advanced levels. Includes 2 Ergo 50 ratchets on 30 cm slings, 2 adjustable Bera tree protectors, a 5/8" shackle, a 2 m anchor sling, 4 m of 10 mm semi-static rope, 2 backups and a bag. 9 kg is the shipping weight, so weight is left null. A 25 m version is also sold (R$619, in stock). The 30 m one was out of stock on 2026-09-29. Description left blank because only a Portuguese page exists.

name: Andy Lewis Trickline
notes: Andy Lewis signature set. Listed by Slackhouse (slackhouseshop.pl), which names Gibbon as the producer, so it is filed under Gibbon per the master list's retailer rule. Contents: a 22 m Andy Lewis Line (the spec table says 20 m, the contents list 22 m, and 22 m is recorded), two enlarged ratchets with short loops, 2 m and 3 m slings, 2 stainless shackles. The tree wraps were a Slackhouse giveaway, not part of the Gibbon set. Polyester, 50 mm, MBS 30 kN, 6.6 kg unpacked (7.3 kg packed), made in China. 'Sweet Spot' print marks the middle of the line. Discontinued: sold out at Slackhouse and absent from Gibbon's own shop. Description left blank because only a Polish page was checked.

name: Jibline
notes: Listed by Slackhouse (slackhouseshop.pl), which names Gibbon as the producer, so it is filed under Gibbon per the master list's retailer rule. 15 m set: a 12.5 m Jibline plus a ratchet on a 2.5 m loop, with a ratchet cover. Polyester, 50 mm, MBS 30 kN, 2.7 kg, rubber-printed surface, TÜV certified, made in China. Tree-shirt S wraps were optional. Regular price 389 PLN (on sale for 319 PLN when it sold out). Recorded as historic at the owner's call. Gibbon still sells a 'JIBLINE TREEWEAR SET' on gibbon-slacklines.com, which is not this listing. Description left blank because only a Polish page was checked.
